title: Empty Word Crash
description: title_case(text) capitalizes the first letter of every word and keeps the spacing exactly as it was, double spaces included.
hint: What does `"a  b".split(" ")` return? Look at the middle item.
explanation: Splitting on a single space turns double spaces into empty strings, and `""[0]` raises IndexError. Slicing never raises: `word[:1]` is `""` for an empty word, so the code handles it without a special case.
